description: This file implements a screenshotter class using Playwright and manages shared browser instances for rendering diff views as images or PDFs, including browser path resolution and resource management.

classes.name: PlaywrightDiffScreenshotter
classes.description: A class that provides methods to take HTML screenshots of diffs using Playwright, managing shared browser instances and rendering options.

methods.name: screenshotHtml
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of provided HTML content, handling browser setup, viewport sizing, and PDF or PNG output.

methods.name: resetSharedBrowserStateForTests
methods.description: Resets the shared browser state and executable path cache, primarily for testing purposes.
